```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
monona <- read_csv("../../data/lake-monona-winters-2024.csv")
model = lm(duration~year1, monona)
summary(model)
```


```{r}
# 95% CI for beta_1 in the monona dataset

beta_1_hat = -0.22298
cv = qt(0.975, 167)
se = 0.02667

beta_1_hat + c(-1, 1)*cv*se
```


```{r}
t = beta_1_hat/se # test statistic
t

t1 = (beta_1_hat-1)/se
t1
```


```{r}
# p value for the left (lower) tail because the test statistic is negative

p_val = pt(t, 167) 
p_val

p_val_2_sided = 2*p_val
```


```{r}
t1 = (beta_1_hat-1)/se
t1
pt(t1, 167, lower.tail = F)
pt(t1, 167)
```


```{r}
predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "prediction")
```

```{r}
predict(lm(duration~year1, monona), newdata = tibble(year1 = 2024:2030), interval = "confidence")
```
